button.label: Create / Update
button.screentip: Create or update the Sankey chart
button.supertip: Select a table with three columns (From, To, Value) - or click one cell inside it - and press this button. If a chart already exists on the sheet it is rebuilt from its source table.

button.label: Delete
button.supertip: Removes the Sankey chart from the active sheet and stops auto-updating it. Your data is not touched.

editBox.label: Title:
editBox.supertip: Shown at the top-left of the chart. Leave empty for no title.

editBox.label: Subtitle:
editBox.supertip: A short description shown under the title. Leave empty for none.

dropDown.label: Colors:
dropDown.supertip: Palette used for nodes and flows. 'Workbook theme' uses the colors applied under Page Layout > Colors (e.g. your company palette). 'Custom palette' uses colors imported with Import palette.

dropDown.label: Flows:
dropDown.supertip: Solid = colored by source node. Gradient = fades from source to target color. Gray = neutral flows.

checkBox.label: Show values on labels
checkBox.supertip: Adds each node's total next to its name.

button.label: Change node color
button.screentip: Change the color of one node
button.supertip: Click the chart, then click a node (or its label) once more so it is selected on its own, then press this button and pick a color. The color is remembered for that node, also when the chart updates. Clicking a flow recolors the node it starts from.

menu.label: Import palette
menu.supertip: Load brand colors from cells or from a file, then use them via Colors > Custom palette.

button.label: From selected cells...
button.supertip: Select cells filled with your colors, or cells containing hex codes (#E4002B) or RGB values (228,0,43). Up to 20 colors, read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. White is ignored.

button.label: From a text / CSV / XML file...
button.supertip: Reads hex codes or RGB triples from .txt, .csv, .gpl or .css files, or an Office theme-colors .xml file.

button.label: Clear custom palette
button.supertip: Removes the imported palette and returns to the Corporate palette.

button.label: Reset node colors
button.supertip: Removes all per-node color changes so every node follows the selected palette again.

editBox.label: Width:
editBox.supertip: Total chart width in points. Default 960.

editBox.label: Height:
editBox.supertip: Total chart height in points. Default 560.

editBox.label: Unit:
editBox.supertip: Text shown after values, e.g. USD, kg, GWh. Leave empty for none.

checkBox.label: Auto-update chart
checkBox.supertip: When on, the chart redraws automatically when a value or name in its source table changes, or when you add a row directly below the table. Note: each redraw clears Excel's Undo history.

button.label: Sample data
button.supertip: Adds a new sheet with an example budget table and its Sankey chart.

button.label: How to use
button.supertip: Short guide: data layout, auto-update, design options and tips.
